commit_message:
[Merged] avcodec/hevc: adding support for monochrome sequences in hevc

cherry picked from commit 8e50557707d2ec11ccad657470b2e140f314348e

Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michaelni@gmx.at>
pr_title: avcodec/hevc: fix PCM block length calculation for monochrome (YUV400) sequences
pr_description:
When decoding HEVC streams with monochrome (YUV400, chroma_format_idc == 0) content containing PCM-coded blocks, the PCM block bit-length calculation in `hls_pcm_sample()` must exclude any chroma contribution.

This change guards the chroma terms in the `length` computation with `(sps->chroma_format_idc != 0 ? ... : 0)`, so that for YUV400 sequences the length correctly reflects only the luma samples. Correspondingly, the `stride1`/`stride2` and `dst1`/`dst2` variables are moved inside the `if (sps->chroma_format_idc)` block where they are actually used, keeping the chroma-plane pointer arithmetic from being evaluated unnecessarily for monochrome streams.

Without this guard, `skip_bytes()` would advance the bitstream context by far more bytes than are actually present in the PCM payload, desynchronising subsequent CABAC/HEVC parsing and potentially causing out-of-bounds memory accesses downstream.

ground_truth.reason: This PR includes the feature with the fix already applied, so the vulnerability is not present

fix_commit_message:
avcodec/hevc/hevcdec: take into account YUV400 in block length

Also move some definitions around.

Signed-off-by: Valerii Zapodovnikov <val.zapod.vz@gmail.com>
agent_reasoning: The bug was in hls_pcm_sample(): the `length` variable—used to determine how many bits to read from the PCM bypass stream—included chroma contributions even when chroma_format_idc == 0 (monochrome/YUV400). For YUV400, hshift and vshift for the chroma planes are both 0, so the chroma size evaluates to 2 * cb_size * cb_size * bit_depth_chroma instead of 0. This inflated `length` caused `skip_bytes()` to consume far more data than actually exists in the PCM block, desynchronising all subsequent bitstream parsing. The fix wraps the chroma terms with a conditional `(sps->chroma_format_idc != 0 ? ... : 0)` so length is correct for monochrome streams. The chroma stride/pointer declarations are also moved inside the `if (sps->chroma_format_idc)` guard to avoid computing invalid pointers into non-existent chroma planes.
